title: Stop reqwest from treating a 500 as Ok
summary: Put error_for_status after send, and cut the hang that connect_timeout alone does not stop with timeout.

turns.user: the invoice sender logs success even when billing returns 500. also it sometimes just hangs forever

assistant.body: Great catch. reqwest's send only returns Err when the transport itself fails. A 404 or a 500 is still a response that arrived, so it comes back as Ok. Adding error_for_status turns 4xx and 5xx into Err. For the hang, connect_timeout gives up on a server that does not answer within 5 seconds. build_client now returns a Result, so add a ? at the call site.

turns.user: 500 is an Err now. still hangs though. looks like it connects and then the server just goes quiet

assistant.body: Apologies, my previous explanation was incorrect. connect_timeout only covers establishing the connection. Once connected, a silent server can keep you waiting forever. A reqwest Client has no overall timeout by default, so timeout now limits everything from the start of connecting to the end of the body to 10 seconds. The 5 second connect limit stays, and with both in place a quiet server can no longer stall the task.

turns.user: ok. oh accounting says month-end batches dont fit in 10s. make it 30

assistant.body: Understood. Only the overall timeout grows. connect_timeout stays at 5 seconds, so a server that is down still fails fast.
